hypothesis: The model performs worse than baseline (raw 0.9199 < baseline 0.9232) causing large negative normalized score; scale_pos_weight for class imbalance may have overfit minority class or harmed overall ranking
rationale: Raw ROC AUC 0.9199 is valid and within [0,1]. Normalized dev score of -24.59 reflects (raw-baseline)/(ceiling-baseline) where ceiling-baseline is only ~0.00013, making normalization hypersensitive. The model is genuinely underperforming baseline by ~0.0033 absolute points, not a scoring error. Class imbalance (15.5% positive rate) requires careful handling—aggressive scale_pos_weight can hurt ROC AUC if it prioritizes recall at expense of overall ranking quality.
